title: Returning Landlord Credit on the CondoGuard Rental Charge
content:
**What is the returning-landlord multiplier on the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy?** It is a multiplier on the rental charge of a unit rental endorsement that looks at the unit's earlier rental on the same policy. The returning-landlord multiplier looks at the unit's earlier rental, measured in whole months from the effective date of the latest unit rental endorsement added to the effective date of the latest unit rental endorsement removed: it is 0.90 when a unit rental endorsement was earlier removed from the policy and that earlier rental had stayed on for 24 or more whole months, 0.96 when a unit rental endorsement was earlier removed and that earlier rental had stayed on for fewer than 24 whole months, and 1.00 when no unit rental endorsement was ever removed from the policy. The multiplier is applied to the sum of the tier's unit rental annual premium and the landlord liability load, before the full-year rental charge is rounded. Where that sum carries more than one rental multiplier, they are first multiplied together and then applied once to the sum; none of them acts on the result of another.

**Which entries are read?** The policy's endorsement entries for the unit rental endorsement: whether any removal of it exists, the effective date of the latest one added and the effective date of the latest one removed.

| Unit rental endorsement ever removed from the policy | Earlier rental, whole months from latest added to latest removed | Returning-landlord multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 24 or more | 0.90 |
| yes | fewer than 24 | 0.96 |
| no | not measured | 1.00, no returning-landlord adjustment |

**Worked questions (hypothetical histories).**

- *A rental endorsement added effective 1 May of one year and removed effective 1 May two years later?* 24 whole months, so 0.90.
- *Added effective 1 May and removed effective 30 April two years later?* 23 whole months, a part month not counted, so 0.96.
- *A policy on which a rental endorsement was never removed?* 1.00.
